d: Adam and the guys visit Lowell at his new bachelor pad and start using it to get away from their home lives; Andi keeps pushing Adam for her own desk at the office.
When Adam catches Kate sneaking back into the house at night, he is determined to fix the behavior with old-school parenting tactics; Andi is dismayed when she can't find many baby pictures of Emme.
Adam and Andi go to great lengths to secure a loan to fix an unexpected issue on their flip house.
Adam and Andi are eager to book a night away in a hotel after Teddy keeps sleeping in their bed; Kate is allowed to stay home alone but doesn't follow Adam and Andi's strict rules.
When Adam offers to go on a vegan diet with Kate in an effort to bond with her, his love of meat proves a hard habit to break.
After Adam throws out his back on his 50th birthday, he is still determined to take a dirt bike excursion and check it off his bucket list; Don and Adam give out bonuses at work.
Adam gets jealous when Teddy names Andi as his hero for a school essay.
When Adam accidentally invites Andi to go on the guys' annual trip, he tries to un-invite her, which only makes matters worse.
Adam recruits Marcy to put Andi's snooty sister in her place when she comes for a visit.
When Adam and Andi see how much Lowell's new relationship with Andi's sister is changing him, they stage an intervention to get him to stop putting up with her bad behavior.
When Andi's doctor advises her to stop taking birth control pills, Adam and Andi disagree on an alternate option.
Dave has a cold that has him acting like a baby, and Debbie's treating him like one; Rebecca and Joanna, however, think he's overreacting and are concerned he's going to ruin their spa weekend away
Adam and Don become super protective of Lowell when they think he might get back together with his cheating ex-wife; Joe experiences an unexpected side effect from his new pacemaker.
Adam and Andi offer Teddy dating advice but wind up making things super awkward for him instead.
Adam encourages Don to give himself food poisoning to get out of babysitting his destructive grandson; Adam and Andi argue over who has to take Kate and her teenage friends dress shopping.
When Adam buys a boat without asking Andi, they wind up in couples therapy to settle the disagreement.
Adam discovers someone is sneaking his boat out at night, and he assumes the culprits are Don and Joe; after Andi makes Kate get a job at the mall, Kate decides she no longer wants to go to college.

When Adam and Don disagree about a new house to flip for their construction business, their bickering reveals bigger issues in their relationship; Andi goes to great lengths to throw the perfect birthday party for Bev.

st: Stuck In The Middle With You
d: Adam's mother-in-law Alice makes an unexpected visit and reveals some shocking news.
When Adam and Andi resort to their usual punishment in response to Teddy's bad grades, his unexpected reaction catches them off guard.

st: Adam and Andi See Other People
d: Adam and Andi attempt to spice up their social life by making new friends.
Adam has trouble helping Katie prepare for her driving test; Don turns to Lowell for help romancing Marcy.
Adam tries to give Andi the perfect 20th wedding anniversary gift by re-creating their honeymoon.
